reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: Investment scam
reports.description: At the beginning of June 2022, I signed up with the Lifetime Investments platform. I was called by a financial advisor Sara Olofsson who claimed that she was my financial adviser she promised high returns. She told me how to make transfers and deposits to the platform. I sent Bitcoin from Binance and then sent it to the wallet address provided by the platform. Then  Mrs. Emily Davies gave me trading advice and beginning in July, Emily Davies began pressuring me to pay greater investments, promising me a four-fold return on my money within three months. I tried to withdraw but there were additional, costs that needed to be paid. An individual named  Lucas  from the financial division called me and informed me that I needed to pay in order to receive the withdrawal. Which led to the freezing of my accounts with the platform until I paid. I transferred the funds to the ‘’LifeTime Investments’’ platform to their wallet address. The ‘’LifeTime Investments’’company then sent a subsequent email alerting me that a new payment was required to two distinct wallet addresses. The ‘’LifeTime Investments’’ demanded further payments. ‘’LifeTime Investments’’ informed me that they had a total of €30,000 on hold but those additional payments were needed. When I contacted ‘’LifeTime Investments’’and accused them of being scammers, they responded by saying they would transfer the money back to the investment company. I was informed the new commissions would have to be paid in order to follow through with any withdrawals. I contacted the Binance exchange directly, They said the lifetime investment platform has no relations with them and they are likely a fraud-run organization. This was seen as an imposter email from the company acting as the Binance AML Team.

reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: investment scram
reports.description: At the beginning of June 2022, I was contacted via phone call by an individual who introduced herself as Julia with the investment opportunity. This person reassured me about her legitimate intentions and convinced me to send me personal information such as my ID and selfie in order for me to be eligible to join the cryptocurrency investment platform. Two days later I received a message from an individual allegedly named David Olsson, a representative of BlockFI. In order to confirm that he is a real person, I was sent a link to his LinkedIn. David Olsson reassured me that I would receive stable returns and immediate withdrawals upon agreeing to receive his guidance in the cryptocurrency investment process. David Olsson affected me about his legitimacy by sharing the alleged story of his life. Due to my health condition, I was easy to fall into David Olsson’s offer and decided to do the initial transfer into the platform. I was provided with the bank details to send my funds. During my conversations with David Olsson, I was reassured I will receive an iPhone as well as will meet David Olsson in person. David Olsson would use AnyDesk to control my Binance account.\r\nOn the 15th of August, David Olsson requested me to make a transfer for a big amount. I refused as I started suspecting that I was being scammed. I did not receive my funds back up until today.

reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: Investment scam
reports.description: At the end of May 2022, I signed up with the Lifetime Investments platform, after which I was called by an Account Manager named Lucas Moore. I was told how to make transfers and deposits to the platform, and was shown his account page. I would fund his account by purchasing Bitcoin from Binance and then sending it to the wallet address provided by the platform. The account manager then began directing my trading experience via AnyDesk, wherein he would open/close positions on my behalf. Eventually, I decided to withdraw after spending some time trading with the platform. I agreed to pay a tax in order to withdraw, only to be told that there was an issue with the platform's bank (Allegedly Santander). Following that, I was called by a manager named  Noah  who said that I had to pay an additional amount in order to receive the withdrawal. I then refused, which led to the freezing of my accounts with the platform until I paid a very significant sum. I then insisted that the amount be paid from my existing balance, which the platform refused. The platform then began pressuring me by claiming that they were adding significant interest on the amount I owes.
